title: H1c: functional change over grey-matter ROIs (synthetic)
description: Within-animal change in ReHo, fALFF and functional connectivity summaries over the atlas grey matter, and the group difference in that change, over three windows, with the cross-sectional contrasts as diagnostics.

inference.method: per test, a linear model with the cuprizone cohort modelled (size-weighted); t test of the contrast

correction.family: none: each test on its own; the ROI rows are post hoc
correction.statement: p per test from the cohort model's t, uncorrected across tests, measures and ROIs

effect.scope: grey-matter-wide and hemisphere summaries (tests); one ROI (ROI rows: d)
effect.definition: the contrast in the measure's own units (mean change, or cuprizone minus control) with a 95% bootstrap interval; Cohen's d (pooled SD, ignoring cohort) is beside it, without an interval

tables.rows: one measure's grey-matter-wide summary in one contrast
tables.description: every measure and contrast, significant or not

tables.rows: one measure's left or right summary in one contrast
one ROI in one measure and contrast (post hoc)

caveats: Every value is synthetic (tests/fixtures/mri_h1c/make_spec.py); only the structure is the H1c export's.
Only the group difference in change over p60→p120 is the registered test; the other contrasts are descriptive.
Cohen's d carries no interval in this export, so the summary reports the contrast estimate with its bootstrap interval.
